codebase_notes.src/models.py: Record creates timestamps and IDs, consumes _source/_tags/_meta with pop, serializes data, and merges records. BatchResult counts successes and failures, computes a rate, caps serialized errors at ten, and supports aggregate merging.
codebase_notes.src/metrics.py: Counter, Gauge, and Histogram share a name-keyed registry. Histogram supports count, sum, mean, percentiles, and bucket counts. The timed and counted decorators wrap arbitrary function calls. Registry factories return existing entries without a runtime class check.
codebase_notes.src/cache.py: TTLCache stores values and expiry times, evicts expired entries, then evicts the earliest expiry if full. The cached decorator builds a key from args and sorted kwargs, treats None as a miss, and assigns cache/cache_clear attributes to the wrapper.
codebase_notes.src/csv_source.py: CSV ingestion tries blank, numeric, date, and boolean conversions, then stores the original string. It adds source and file/line metadata and creates Record objects. Helpers provide batches, delimiter detection, and row counts; skip_header is accepted but not used in read_csv_batch.
codebase_notes.src/db.py: A locked SQLite pool limits connections and tracks use. execute_query returns row dictionaries for SELECT and rowcount for other statements. Query helpers release connections in finally blocks. DatabaseSession commits or rolls back on exit and returns False.
codebase_notes.src/writer.py: BaseWriter buffers records, flushes on size/close, and provides a context manager. JsonWriter emits an array; CsvWriter infers fieldnames and writes rows; NullWriter discards rows. The factory selects these classes. write_records counts successes and failures in BatchResult.
codebase_notes.src/validation.py: Schema validation checks required values, types, string and numeric bounds, regex patterns, choices, and custom predicates. It returns a boolean and error list. Helpers validate batches and build schemas; predefined user/product schemas are available, and lookup can return None.
codebase_notes.src/transform.py: Named transforms compose dictionary transformations and may filter records with None. Built-ins normalize keys, strip whitespace, remove nulls, and add computed fields. Other helpers filter required fields, rename fields, and build configured pipelines; unknown names are logged and skipped.
codebase_notes.src/scheduler.py: Job stores a callable, arguments, interval, last-run time, counters, optional last error, and enabled state. execute records failures and returns None on exceptions. Registry helpers add/remove/query jobs; run_pending checks due jobs; run_loop sleeps between checks.
codebase_notes.src/logging_setup.py: Logging setup configures a stderr StreamHandler and optional FileHandler once. Helpers return loggers, set named levels, and quiet named third-party loggers. Both handler types enter the same list.
codebase_notes.src/db_source.py: Table readers build SELECT queries, transform columns, create Record objects, and paginate with LIMIT/OFFSET. Ingestion records BatchResult counts. Row-count helpers return the cnt field or fallback values; query results depend on db.execute_query.
codebase_notes.src/config.py: Configuration loads YAML from an optional path or INGESTD_CONFIG, applies environment overrides, and caches the result. Helpers traverse dotted keys and deep-merge dictionaries with later values winning.
codebase_notes.src/api_source.py: fetch_page calls requests.get and returns JSON. Pagination builds Record objects, and polling invokes an optional callback with error limits. Auth-header helper source is visible, but no actual credential value or provider request header appears in these reads. ingest_from_api constructs auth but does not pass it to fetch_all_pages.
codebase_notes.src/cli.py: The CLI dispatches ingest, daemon, status, and validate. CSV ingestion validates and transforms records before write_records; API/database ingestion reports BatchResult. Daemon registers source jobs. Status reports jobs; validate checks a CSV file. main loads config, configures logging, and selects a handler.
